title: Betty Lou Fish Company
specs: Captain Nate is USCG licensed and passionate about fishing and sight fishing cobia and red drum
Fishing grounds centered around Chesapeake Bay Bridge Tunnel, sometimes nearshore Atlantic
Recommended maximum 4 guests for fishing trips, 6 for non-fishing charters
No experience needed; captain is hands on and teaches
Fishing trips recommended for not more than 4 guests; non-fishing charters no more than 6 guests

options.name: Non-fishing charters
options.detail: Sunset cruise, bay floats, Lynnhaven River Tours

variants.label: Sunset cruise, bay floats, Lynnhaven River Tours

includes: Cooler space with ice and bottled water
blurb: Guests fish for species like cobia and red drum in the lower Chesapeake Bay and nearshore Atlantic. The captain provides all fishing gear, bait, and licensing. Non-fishing charters include sunset cruises, bay floats, and Lynnhaven River Tours.
extraNote: Legal fish can be kept according to VMRC size and quantity limits · Morning Star Marina at 8166 Shore Drive in Norfolk, alongside the main dock near the large forklifts by the big boat storage building.
